# Dekel Nissim — Portfolio

> Portfolio site of Dekel Nissim, a Product Designer and UX Researcher. It presents
> case studies of product design work, written articles, and contact details.
> The site is a client-rendered single-page app, so this file describes its content
> for agents that do not execute JavaScript.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Introduction, client list, case-study overview, and client testimonials.
- [About](/about): Background, approach to evidence-based design, and experience.
- [Articles](/articles): Index of articles, available in English and Hebrew.
- [Business card](/business-card): Freelance one-pager with a contact form.

## Case studies

- [Salary Additions](/salaries): Internal system automating salary calculations and approvals.
- [Marketer](/marketer): Marketing product design work.
- [Myco](/myco): Product design case study.
- [Employee Onboarding](/employees): Onboarding experience design.

## Notes

- Individual articles live at `/articles/{slug}`; the slugs are listed on the articles page.
- There is no public API. The contact form posts to a private backend service.
